describes: Current redaction selection/search/area marks, pending ownership and apply lifecycle.

cases.name: initial-state-and-twins
cases.covers: A fresh slice is idle. Marking reads annotation create authority; apply requires the redaction service and all three engine grants.

cases.name: mark-the-text-selection
cases.covers: The current selection creates a mark per selected page from page-space segments, clears selection, and reads the confirmed marks.

cases.name: marking-needs-create-authority
cases.covers: Marking rejects permission-denied without create authority and leaves the text selection intact.

cases.name: the-redact-tool
cases.covers: The actual interaction tool activates redact, draws an area through annotation createPointer, and switches to pointer and back.

cases.name: without-a-selection-plugin
cases.covers: Without selection the composed redact tool is absent: activating it rejects not-found; markSelection rejects unsupported.

cases.name: pending-projection
cases.covers: Pending is a synchronous projection of current loaded annotations, in page order, with current refs and page indices.

cases.name: estimate-collateral
cases.covers: Positive area overlap uses quad boxes in preference to the mark rect and counts each non-mark once.

cases.name: apply-named-marks
cases.covers: Apply filters explicit current refs. Busy begins before settlement; the confirmed event records the result and callback, and unsubscribe removes its listener.

cases.name: apply-all-pages
cases.covers: ApplyAll sends every current page, including unloaded pages, with fact provenance and both listeners.

cases.name: apply-refused
cases.covers: A refused second apply clears busy, preserves the previous confirmed result and pending annotations, and publishes no false applied fact.

cases.name: apply-refusals-before-the-engine
cases.covers: Empty and unknown refs reject not-found; an empty document rejects not-ready; the required redaction service can refuse with EngineError Unsupported, then recover. Historical absent-service semantics are archived.

cases.name: remote-applies-arrive-as-events
cases.covers: Both local and remote confirmed redaction events update lastResult; unrelated events do not. Closing releases listeners.

cases.name: a-throwing-listener-is-isolated
cases.covers: A throwing onApplied callback reaches the kernel report; the next callback still runs and the apply succeeds.

cases.name: set-label
cases.covers: updateLabel writes explicit patch members and preserves the current font styling; non-mark and missing refs reject.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the target is not a redaction mark

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: the target is not a redaction mark

cases.name: mark-area-and-page
cases.covers: Page-space rectangles and full visible page sizes take configured overlay defaults. Missing pages and absent create authority reject; pending events omit non-mark creations.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: page 9 is not in this document

cases.name: an-overlay-without-values-adds-nothing
cases.covers: A partial empty overlay is merged with current settings defaults; marking still receives the default fill and text styling.

cases.name: mark-search-matches
cases.covers: Actual search results yield one mark per segmented hit in hit order; the page filter selects only page two.

cases.name: marking-refusals
cases.covers: Missing search or selection rejects unsupported only after authority passes; denied create rejects permission-denied.

cases.name: unmark-and-clear
cases.covers: Unmark applies pending refs, skips others, and reports per-mark refused deletes while retaining the refused mark. Confirmed delete events publish pending page changes.

cases.name: apply-pages
cases.covers: Empty pages reject invalid-input; current page refs resolve to a pages scope and lastResult reflects the engine fact.

cases.name: pending-reads
cases.covers: Current objectNumber and baseIndex refs resolve pending marks; page filters are stable, absent pages are empty, and page counts agree.

cases.name: update-label-refused
cases.covers: An engine label refusal rejects and rolls back. A later successful edit carries the unchanged overlay label and fires pending changed.

cases.name: mark-ownership-and-flags
cases.covers: Self-scoped authority allows the owned mark only; foreign, unstamped and locked marks refuse without dispatch. Owned update and removal publish facts.

cases.name: apply-queue-and-unchanged-page
cases.covers: Queued applies compute refs when their turn begins. Each confirmed single-page apply removes its mark while page two survives unchanged.

cases.name: close-during-apply
cases.covers: Closing a document cancels its pending apply and releases the event listener; a later engine settlement cannot publish an applied callback into the closed instance.

$error.name: PluginError
$error.message: a state update after the instance closed (a#1); dropped
